    gsl.gsl_stats_skew.argtypes = [

    point = (ctypes.c_double * dimension)()

    brent_iterate.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)

    # Create GSL function

    gsl_func.function = ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_void_p)(wrapped_func)
    gsl_func.params = ctypes.cast(ctypes.byref(ctypes.py_object(func)), ctypes.c_void_p)

    # Create minimizer

    minimizer = gsl.gsl_min_fminimizer_alloc(minimizer_type)

    while iter < max_iter:

    gsl.gsl_histogram_set_ranges_uniform(hist, ctypes.c_double(xmin), ctypes.c_double(xmax))

    result = []

        high = ctypes.c_double()

    gsl.gsl_histogram_free(hist)

    gsl.gsl_multiset_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_multiset)]
